summary:
Inspected existing ExistingInActAt dossier and the pre-existing EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround declaration before implementation. Added metadata DEF/STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND for that unchanged OPEN interface; recording it does not prove it or attribute it to a source. Added ONE eight-input result with existing conclusion STMT-UNIQUE-NECESSARY-ACTUAL-ROOT. Three source-free non-corpus shared helpers: maximumEqualsRoot identifies each supplied maximum with a supplied actual root via genus, existing-world esse actuality and direct esse/ground correspondence; maximumExistsOfExistingRoot imports the existing actualFork/actualCore using root existence as esse population; necessaryRootCommonGround retains that same actual root and its necessity and derives selected direct grounds from it to every other actual concretum, including contingent recipients. The registered uniqueRoot imports WholeRosterFoundation.necessaryActualRoot and those helpers; a distinct actual root contradicts the common incoming ground without needing to establish that second root necessary. Challenge frozen before Solution SHA256b7fcbf6355cdc626203cdeceb1a8231ca660a14fdef602efde1e9e68c6c0bd18. Exact eight inputs: Pop,Whole,Dep,EM,Genus,ExistingInActAt,EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround,GradesHaveMaximum. Compared to the earlier nine-input result, four retained foundation/logical inputs and genus/grades remain, three necessity-specific interfaces are replaced by two direct existing-actuality/cause-ground interfaces. Different stronger recipient coverage is not a global weakening or least-bundle claim. Prose/type sweep: ActualRoot/unique-root conclusion remains selected-world/selected-relation only; necessary nonroots remain possible; direct coverage targets all actual concrete x distinct from n, not absent/nonconcrete targets, self-links, all worlds or complete explanatory sufficiency. No new UniqueRoot predicate, source claim, model, maximum-comparison or God-naming premise. Same-world existence does not assert temporal concurrence. Focused core/Solution Lean diagnostics, corpus consistency and diff whitespace pass; all three helper and uniqueRoot axiom reports are empty; final binding/Comparator/NanoDa remain coordinator integration. No shared imports, prior batch files or other worker files modified. Shared convention sourceRevision c104800c7aaeaea12d56f9093e71bdef6a2ce6fa. Coordinator full build passes (4280 jobs), exact binding reports777 bound/2existing pins/0mismatch; all4newresults and3affected existing whole-roster results pass zero-permitted-axiom Comparator and independent NanoDa. Measured vs main22e1cfe8: GodExists adds cost11/direct12 and cost12/direct13, GodIsOne adds cost6/direct7, unique necessary actual root adds cost7/direct8. Existing routes unchanged; God/GodIsOne unions64→66 and16→18 add only ExistingInActAt and direct esse-ground correspondence; Catholic union73 unchanged. These measurements neither establish premise truth nor globally weaker coverage than earlier necessity-only bundles. SourceRevision625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0.

WORLD/TIME LEDGER-F AUDIT (2026-11-01): Inspected exact EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround, ActualConcreteGround and ActualRoot types plus existing temporal/history records/dossier. F retains c≠x, ActualConcrete m w x and supplied CausesIn c x esse as antecedents; its consequent is concrete c, ExistsAt w c and grounds w c x at SAME w. No Time, now or temporal concurrence occurs. Existing DEF-BRUTE-ROOT-RELATIVE-GROUNDING permits possible complete histories; DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT explicitly says present means world-relative existence, not temporal concurrence/presentism. DISAMB-TEMPORAL-HISTORY-EXISTENCE-AXES and DISAMB-HISTORY-TIME-SCOPE distinguish world, time and optional CoherentAtNow. A past producer can exist in the actual history without being alive now. Rejected stronger reading that F requires a presently acting/now-existing cause; that would need a separate time/coherence interface, not a silent interpretation of this type. Historical production still does not establish the supplied esse-cause or selected ground relation merely by being production; production, sustaining causation, ordinary Ontic.Causes and grounds remain distinct application obligations. Known q44a1ad2 counterfactual dependence is not a time-indexed sustaining law. LedgerF wording and the independent STMT paraphrase now match world-level guards; recording-status/scope prose moved to its note, with existing history disambiguations linked. Existing CF4 world-versus-now discussion is consistent and unchanged. No Lean/relation/source premise/owner truth status or conditional consequence changes; intended and actual premise delta NONE. Focused corpus check PASS (2755 statements,1909 claims,471 passages; existing unrelated Frege-Geach warning only), whitespace PASS. No source pin or formal dependency changed; no heavy verification repeated. Coordinator and independent three-file review PASS: world-relative existence, no temporal concurrence and unchanged causal/application requirements. Root self-sweep makes the statement conditional grammar explicit so the esse-cause is unambiguously c, not recipient x; old Lean declarations, premise meanings and source bindings are unchanged. No owner truth selection or root-frontier change.

Coverage is conditional direct selected grounding, not proof of explanatory sufficiency or semantic reality correspondence.
